text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday, Gran-chan! Did you like 
your present?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll cherish this handmade 
pouch forever and ever♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, if you'd like, try putting your 
favorite earphone case in there, 
Gran-chan. I made sure the gusset fits it 
perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Hawaaa~! Really and truly made just for 
me...! I'm touched a hundred miles over!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Alright! In times like these, you 
gotta...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
My rule number four! 'Eat a date whenever 
you're happy!'

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Seeing you this happy makes me feel 
happy too~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You know what? On the "SMILE" logo on my 
pouch, I changed the color of just the 
"S". And when you do that...?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ! It's packed with miles and smiles!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
As expected of our Mile senior! I'm 
infinitely happy, by miles and miles~!!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
One bag of dates isn't going to be 
enough...! I need to run to the 
supermarket to buy more!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, make sure not to eat too much, okay? 
Everything in moderation~!
